meta.name: agent-protocol
meta.description: Inter-agent communication protocol for C-suite agent teams. Defines invocation syntax, loop prevention, isolation rules, and response formats. Use when C-suite agents need to query each other, coordinate cross-functional analysis, or run board meetings with multiple agent roles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定义高管级智能体间的通信协议与协作规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建需要多个C级智能体协同工作的系统
copy.tagline_en: Define communication protocols and coordination rules for C-suite agent teams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building systems where multiple C-suite agents need to collaborate

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以扮演CEO、CFO等高管角色，通过[INVOKE:角色|问题]格式互相提问，并按照固定格式回复。它还能防止循环调用、记录决策，并在董事会会议中执行独立分析和批评。
howto.when: 当高管角色需要互相查询数据、协调跨职能分析，或召开包含多个角色的董事会会议时触发。

say.text: 请CFO评估Q3招聘5名工程师对现金流的影响。
CEO向所有角色广播：如果我们错过融资会有什么影响？
say.note: Claude会以CEO身份广播，各角色独立回复后汇总。

say.text: 检查CFO和CRO的预测是否存在冲突。
say.note: Claude会执行冲突解决流程，标记矛盾并给出处理建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can act as C-suite roles (CEO, CFO, etc.), query each other using [INVOKE:role|question] format, and reply in a structured format. It prevents circular calls, logs decisions, and enforces independent analysis during board meetings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when C-suite agents need to query each other, coordinate cross-functional analysis, or run board meetings with multiple agent roles.

say_en.text: Ask CFO to evaluate the cash flow impact of hiring 5 engineers in Q3.
say_en.note: Claude responds as CFO with key finding, supporting data, and confidence.

say_en.text: CEO broadcasts to all roles: What if we miss the fundraise?
say_en.note: Claude broadcasts as CEO; each role responds independently before aggregation.

say_en.text: Check for conflicts between CFO and CRO projections.
say_en.note: Claude runs conflict resolution, flags contradictions, and suggests resolution.
